The '''father''' of the [[holostar]] [[Javul Charn]] and her brother, [[Ayx]], served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], he and [[Javul Charn's mother|his partner]] became [[Musician/Legends|musicians]] and secretly used their tours of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] to run information between resistance cells. Both he and his partner were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in an Imperial raid while performing at a venue on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]].<ref name="Shadow Games" />
